h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Vellore

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Vellore

items.pText: Vellore draws patients and their families from across India to its large hospitals, and many stay in the city for weeks. Children who come along need somewhere to play, and hospital campuses, guest houses and staff quarters can plan a small play corner for them. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for such campuses, and for schools, colleges and colonies in Vellore, at our factory in Vasai East, about 980 km away.

Vellore is known for its fort as well as its university and medical colleges. It has some of the hottest summers in Tamil Nadu, from March to June, and gets its rain mainly from October to December. After the equipment reaches Vellore by road, our team or a dealer in south India installs it. Send us the size of the space and photos, and we will suggest a compact set with a layout drawing marking the safe play area.

items.q: What equipment suits a play corner at a hospital?
items.a: Low, slow pieces such as spring riders, a see-saw and a small play station. They suit children of different ages and are easy for staff to clean and watch.

items.q: How do we keep equipment cool in Vellore's summer?
items.a: Place it in the shade of a building or under a pergola, and choose lighter colours for slides and seats. Morning and evening play avoids the hottest hours.
